# DeepSeek Harness
English | 中文
DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) is an open-source agent harness developed by DeepSeek AI.
It uses an architecture where **everything is a plugin**, and is powered by Cordis, whose design is
described in _A Programming Paradigm for Spatiotemporal Composability_.
## Developer preview
DeepSeek Harness is currently in _developer preview_ and is iterating rapidly. **THERE WILL BE COMPA
TIBILITY-BREAKING CHANGES.**
